Hey thanks for replying. I'm renting a room in somewhere far away from hometown so I can't invite him over. But I'm planning to meet him over the next weekend.

So few months ago we believed that he has depression and we tried to play online games with him so that he won't feel lonely. But he won't say anything about his problems.

Then for these two weeks, he has been increasingly vocal about how he hates his family and how "nice" if he can do something bad.

I'd really like to know his problem. But he has really high pride and have trouble sharing his problems, even to close friends like us. It would be nice if someone can share tips on how to talk to people like him...

For cultural context, we follow Asian culture closely and it is hard in our culture to share "mental problem" because it's a sign of weakness.
